positions.method: X,Z: radar texture matching on 7Lrst9SG3pk 224.8-237.467 (adv_bootcamp radar, gamecontextuiradarinfo (1985,0)=(790,408,103,-58)), identical across the whole arrival hold; +/-1.5 m. Y: the decoded bootcamp map heightmap (Tabula Rasa 1.16.5.0 data/maps/adv_bootcamp/t000007c1_terrain.glm, a stitched 1152x1152 tile grid; 0x7c1 = context 1985; .thd header origin (-512,0,-512), 1 m spacing) sampled at (X,Z). The same decode reproduces a static prop base to 0.03 m (ArchForeanTorchV01 at (398.5,2.5), base 118.34 vs decoded 118.31), so the vertical uncertainty is the 0.25 m height quantum plus slack, +/-1.5 m. rotation: camera heading 345 deg clockwise from +Z toward +X at 238.133 (empirical arrow template score 0.94), low confidence; the server sends the character yaw as radians, so this value is the measured heading, not a verified server convention.
